## Sport & League Page Audit

Starting the Sport & League Page Audit for bainluck.com. I'll systematically discover all pages, audit each one for content completeness, navigation, data quality, and mobile responsiveness, then compile a comprehensive report.

I've completed auditing all pages. Now I'll also check the La Liga and Bundesliga pages (discovered in navigation), then take key screenshots and compile the final report.

I have completed the comprehensive audit of all sport and league pages on bainluck.com. 

I checked all the expected routes, plus two additional ones discovered in the navigation (La Liga and Bundesliga). Every page loaded successfully (200 OK), but there are significant data and UX issues across the board. 

The most critical findings include:
- **Missing Games:** Most league pages (NBA, NHL, NFL, EPL, MLS, etc.) are completely missing the upcoming/live/completed games sections.
- **Broken Navigation:** The "View full grid" link on almost every page links back to the page itself rather than the `/playoffs` route.
- **Data Errors:** There is cross-sport contamination (a squash player listed in Golf), placeholder data (UFC "Fighter A"), and probability math errors (>100% combined odds in EPL/UCL).
- **Incomplete Standings:** Many leagues show partial standings (e.g., NBA only shows 5 teams, NHL 17 teams).

The full detailed report is attached as a Markdown file, along with desktop screenshots for every audited page. Please review the attachments for the complete breakdown of issues by page.
